title: Slovakian Turkey Mince Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful dish made with Slovakian spices, turkey mince, and a crispy casserole top.

ingredients.name: Slovakian paprika
ingredients.notes: Available at most European grocery stores

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced and added to the pan

ingredients.name: Breadcrumbs
ingredients.notes: Panko or regular breadcrumbs work well

instructions: In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the turkey mince to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the turkey is browned, add the Slovakian paprika, caraway seeds, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for another minute.
Transfer the turkey mixture to a 20x20cm baking dish.
Sprinkle the breadcrumbs and grated cheese over the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, until the casserole is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
